sent:
Maya — here’s the teardown you asked for. It focuses on stopping choice friction and timing/rights confusion so more visitors start the one thing you actually want.

Priority fixes (in order):
1) Make Ad Testing Pack the single path on the homepage
- Replace “See Packages” + “Book a call” with one button: “Ad Testing Pack — £1,200”.
- Sample hero copy:
  Headline: Ads your algorithm can learn from.
  Subhead: Ad Testing Pack — 4 scripts, 6 hooks, 3 edits. £1,200. Turnaround: 7–10 days (or 10–14 — pick one and use it everywhere).
  CTA: Start with a 2‑field brief.

2) Replace Quick Brief with two fields
- Keep only Name + Email on first click. Ask brand/URL/budget after they’ve opted in.
- Micro‑choice removal here is the biggest lift.

3) Put proof at the click
- Swap the creator grid near the hero for one 20s best clip plus a single outcome line, e.g. “Top cut hit 5.8% watch‑through” or “Tea brand CTR 1.2% → 2.1%”. Choose one and place it beside the primary button.

4) Unify timings and rights language
- Homepage says 7–10 days; Ad Testing Pack says 10–14. Pick one and use the same phrasing across hero, Packages, FAQ, and enquiry confirmations.
- Standardise “Rush +25%” wording and where it applies.
- Keep “30‑day usage” in FAQ; offer an “extend usage” add‑on there rather than front‑loading fine print.

5) De‑dupe paths to contact
- Merge “Book a quick call” and “Project Enquiry” into one flow: 2‑field brief first, then show live call slots.
- Drop the DM detour at the decision point; keep Instagram in the footer.

6) Package emphasis
- Default the Packages page to Ad Testing Pack with a small “Most chosen” tag.
- Make the CTA “Start Ad Testing Pack”. Keep Starter UGC and Monthly UGC as secondary choices.

7) Small CRO details
- Print price and turnaround next to every primary CTA, not just once.
- If no calendar slots are open, collect email rather than showing a timezone picker and fixed times.

Quick test plan
- Ship the one‑path homepage as Variant B, split traffic 50/50 for 7 days, and compare: primary CTA clicks, brief starts, and booked calls. Keep the winner; iterate the proof block next.
